Name: Better Junimos Crop Fields
Author: micfort
Description:
An extension on Better Junimos mod.
It reimplements the plant crop ability. 
For every crop field it searches for a sign with a crop seed sign. 
In that crop field the junimos will only plant what is on that sign. 
This makes a nicer view of your crops.
You can also control how many are planted of each.

This should still be seen as in Beta.

Also in the configuration of Better Junimos, the plant ability should be disabled.

The source can be found at: https://gitlab.com/micfort/betterjunimoscropfields
